svg.text: Long section (left) and axis-view cross-sections (right). Drawn from the Ship Interior and Hull Spec. Conceptual, not to engineering tolerance.
Ship stands on its tail: bow UP, engines DOWN. Under thrust, down = aft. Each room is one round floor.
Bay fairing 0–12 m: bow array, no decks
A1 control room, 9.6 m, dome in the forward head
A2 officer berths + captain's pod on the axis
A3 array hall 7.6 m, neutrino-line tank access
B2 junction 8.0 m, four hatches, airlock off dorsal wall
One 34 m hall, not stacked. 31 m of hold: 12 tube stations,
each with a port and starboard tube (24), 2.3 m wide, 8.6 m long
from the dorsal wall; 2.1 m lane on the axis, gantry car and rail
(shown orange). Aft bulkhead = down under thrust.
Crew bunks: 3 pods of 8 around the tube bases.
Dashed red = 3 m ventral ordnance gallery: see open point 1.
C1 thermal control 9.6 m, pump tower on the axis
C2+C3 sink machinery hall, valves and lithium pumps
D1 upper: reactor through the grating, 8.4 m shield well
D2 lower: reactor base, switchgear, coilgun breech
1.6 m shield door at the forward end
Unmanned: pumps, pipework, pylon roots (no decks)
Two fusion pods, 18 m x 3.2 m, on pylons (schematic position)
ladder and a 1.2 m side door
The centre of each deck is clear.

g.text: BAYS A, B, C: standard room (looking aft)

svg.text: 10.0 m room, 2.0 m ring, 14.0 m skin
Shield well 8.4 m: ~0.1 m to each shaft
Stair shafts: 1.4 m round, half in the room and half in the ring, one port and one starboard
Keel: coilgun rail, crawl, two water mains (gold outlines)
Reactor well 8.4 m, casing 6 m, on the axis in bay D
Tube 6 EMP blue (flare white to port)
1. Tubes are 8.6 m long in a 10 m cell, leaving 1.4 m to the ventral wall, so the 3 m ventral ordnance gallery
cannot sit inside the cell under the tube bases. It needs to move (annulus or keel) or the tubes need to shorten.
2. Exact fore-aft positions of the laser domes, mast well, docking collar, probe cradle and radiator channels are not
fixed in the spec. They are schematic here.
3. Pod and pylon positions in the aft drive section are schematic (port/starboard assumed).
4. The airlock (4.2 m long, radial) is drawn from the skin inward and overlaps the junction room wall by about 2 m.
Source: docs/ship_interior_hull_spec.md | figures in metres | conceptual reference, 15 November decisions applied
